purpose: RB-058. §43 says Remote Browser Rev 1.5 is production complete only when all of one hundred and four things are true. This is that list with a status against each. `tools/ci/production_acceptance.py` reads §43 out of the blueprint, refuses a requirement that is missing or unclassified, refuses a REPOSITORY_PROVEN row whose evidence does not exist, and recomputes the verdict from the rows — so the ledger cannot claim more than its own rows support.

vocabulary.REPOSITORY_PROVEN: The repository demonstrates it and names what does. Not a claim that it has been observed working on real hardware.
vocabulary.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Needs something no commit can supply: a Browser Stream Host, a carrier, a physical handset. Names which.
vocabulary.OWNER_DEPLOYMENT_DECISION: Needs the owner to provision or accept something: a keystore, a voice asset pack, a second ingress, a look at a screen.
vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON: Does not apply, and says why.

verdict_rule: PRODUCTION_ACCEPTED only when every requirement is REPOSITORY_PROVEN or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON. Anything else is REPOSITORY_COMPLETE_PENDING_EXTERNAL, and the checker recomputes it.
note: REPOSITORY_PROVEN is the strongest thing a repository can say and it is weaker than certification. The programme's distinction holds here: NOT VERIFIED is not NOT IMPLEMENTED, and neither is substituted for the other.

requirements.note: The authority map is the enforcement: every invariant is owned once, and the gate fails on a subject owned twice.
404 rather than 403 for another paired device: one that does not own a session must not learn it exists.
Proven as a decision, not as a click: the queued action is discarded rather than refused later, because an action merely refused is one that runs if anything stops checking.
